5. Taking a leisurely walk around your neighborhood or a nearby park, even if it's raining.
6. Visiting a museum or gallery, if you're looking for something indoor to do.
7. Having a picnic, if you don't mind getting a little wet and can find a sheltered spot to set up your picnic blanket.
8. Going fishing, if you enjoy the sport and have access to a lake or river.
9. Watching a movie or reading a book at a coffee shop or bookstore, if you're looking for something cozy to do inside.
